name: Cephalopods
description: Soft-bodied hunters: the common octopus (Octopus vulgaris) - which underwent a famous boom here in 1986 as predation on its young collapsed - and cuttlefishes (Sepia spp.). Functional group pooling the source's céphalopodes compartment; fast-growing mid-level predators eaten by both tuna groups and marine mammals.
